description: Wonder: The Universe, Discovery, and the Pursuit of Knowledge 
 A conversation with 
 
 Jennifer L. Mnookin 
President, Columbia University in the City of New York 
 and 
 Marcos Balter 
Fritz Reiner Professor of Musical Composition 
 Martin Chalfie 
University Professor 
 Kerstin Perez 
Lavine Family Associate Professor of the Natural Sciences in the Department of Physics 
 Daphna Shohamy 
Kavli Professor of Brain Science; Director and Chief Executive Officer of Columbia's Zuckerman Institute; Co-Director of Columbia's Kavli Institute for Brain Science 
 Samuel Sternberg 
Professor of Biochemistry and Molecular Biophysics 
 
 The Columbia Colloquium is an interdisciplinary conversation series led by President Jennifer L. Mnookin and some of Columbia University’s remarkable faculty members, showcasing Columbia scholarship and addressing big questions that Columbia and universities more broadly face. 
 
In this event, our faculty will explore wonder—inspiration, curiosity, and the drivers of the pursuit of knowledge and discovery. You can view our inaugural Columbia Colloquium here . 
 
Advanced registration is required for in-person attendance. Following the program, we invite you to a brief reception with light refreshments.
